verdict.rationale: The only documented first-party export is retrospectives: teams can draft in Rootly's editor and export a copy to an external editor (rootly-docs-69). That is a narrow slice of the data, in an unspecified format. The REST/JSON API and OpenAPI spec are developer building blocks rather than a data-export feature, and the migration guides cover importing from PagerDuty and Opsgenie, not leaving, so neither earns credit. Missing for 10: bulk export of all data (incidents, timelines, schedules, escalation policies, alerts, workflows), documented open export formats, offboarding or data-portability guidance, and independent corroboration.
